question_evidence_quote: Each layer of cake takes the same amount of sugar to make as a dozen cupcakes.
observed_error: The response assigns half of the total sugar to the two-layer cake.
violated_condition: The two cake layers together require twice the sugar required by the dozen cupcakes.
error_description: The response divides 720 grams by two to assign 360 grams to the entire cake. This division is arithmetically correct but violates the sugar relationship: two cake layers require twice as much sugar as the dozen cupcakes, so the total must be allocated in a 2:1 ratio.
